label: The second or later item marker (a number, lowercase letter or roman numeral) in a list or scale whose items are written with a dash, like '1- tea 2- coffee 3- juice' or '(1 - calm; 10 - spirited)'; it peaks on the marker itself, just before its dash, and needs an earlier marker-plus-dash in the same text (glued '2-' strongest). Second triggers: the '-d' of French c'est-à-dire, a site word right after 'http://' (books, maps), the first comma of a French or German sentence. Quiet: a single 'Option 1 -' with no list, one-off ranges, scores and phone numbers (2010-2014, 3-2), the same lists written with '=', 'means' or plain commas, capital-letter markers, English hyphenated words.
